content: A related comparison of interest is between up-projection and down-projection of the model variables: we note up-projection does visibly better on the language modeling task and slightly better on the downstream tasks. The parameters of a well-trained teacher model represent a high-quality local minimum in the teacher space, which may be easier to search for during up-projection.
